_description: Web page zone: embeds a web page in a dashboard. Pair it with a URL action (url-action.json) to load a page chosen by the user's selection.

zone_node._placement: Inside <dashboard> > <zones>, nested in a layout zone like any other zone (see dashboard-tiled.json).

notes.url_attribute: The page URL goes in param, not url. Tableau writes param='https://...' on web zones. The zone's url attribute is something else.
notes.start_blank: To show nothing until a URL action fires, omit param.
notes.zone_id: id must be unique across all dashboards in the workbook. A URL action targets this zone by id (url-action-target), so keep the two in sync.
notes.no_name_needed: Unlike a visual zone, a web zone doesn't reference a worksheet, so it has no name and no <viewpoint> in the dashboard window.
notes.optional_attrs: scroll='off', show-context-menu='false', suppress-dialogs='true' and error-action='hide' are optional zone attributes that Tableau writes on some web zones.
notes.iframe_limits: The page loads in an iframe. Sites that send X-Frame-Options or a frame-ancestors CSP (many do, e.g. youtube.com watch pages) show as blank. Use an embeddable URL such as https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>.
notes.verification: Web zones render blank in get-view-image PNGs. Check them in a live render, and wait a few seconds for the iframe to load before calling it blank.
